description: Security-specific GATE DEFINITION consumed by the SAME gate-engine.mjs completion.json uses (section 25 of the tool-integration mission) — not a second gate engine. Every check here is an EXISTING, general-purpose check (no-undisposed-findings scoped to CRITICAL/HIGH, criteria-fresh-evidence, no-open-conflicts) except required-capability-available, which is new and opt-in via requiredCapabilities. Run with: node .claude/runtime/gate-engine.mjs security. BLOCK conditions map exactly to section 25: CRITICAL/HIGH confirmed finding undisposed, REQUIRED security evidence missing/stale, an unresolved conflict, or a REQUIRED capability unavailable/failing. MEDIUM/LOW never block here by design.
